annotations.text:
LIFE LEVEL — structural rethink

One core loop, borrowed from modern live-service games:

WORKOUT → Session Results (juice) → feeds the SEASON TRACK (finite battle-pass ladder) + a WORLD MAP (six directions to pick from, below) + the WEEKLY EXPEDITION (this week's bounded run).

Home is a game main menu, not a scroll feed.

HOME — COMMAND CENTER

• Loadout hero: avatar + class + equipped title + 5 stat gems + a single POWER score.
• Season ribbon always on screen. 'Today' deck: Daily Quests, Week 3 Expedition, XP Storm (LIVE), Forest Warden.
• One primary action: START SESSION.

OPTION F — THE LIVING TRAIL: same app, more playable

Every earlier option changed the SCENERY (geography, identity wheel, dungeon, board, side-view). This one keeps the app's actual dark palette and tokens exactly as built on Home/Season/Expedition — and instead changes what the map lets you DO. Four concrete playable moments, stacked on one screen:

① DRAG TO TRAVEL — your token sits on a slingshot-style pull line toward the next landmark; banked km visibly loads the sling, you let go to launch. Real distance becomes a tactile gesture, not a progress bar.
② SPIN THE FORK — route choice becomes an actual prize wheel (Standard / Ridge / Mystery) with a SPIN button, not a static list — a small moment of chance and showmanship at every crossroads.
③ SCRATCH THE FOG — the unrevealed trail ahead is a literal scratch-card foil over a hidden reward, clearing a little more with every workout logged, instead of a passive gradient.
④ TAP TO STRIKE — a boss-proximity combo meter with a big tappable strike button, rewarding logging activity while a boss is near with a visible, game-like hit.

The pitch: keep shipping the world you've already designed — just make touching it feel like play, not paperwork.

OPTION A — THE REALM: geographic season map

The whole season as physical geography — 8 named regions chained bottom to top, mastery stars, timed side POIs, a mini-boss, a live storm event, a guild-frontier marker, a friend's rival ghost.

OPTION B — THE CONSTELLATION: identity, not geography

From this repo's own Obsidian docs (Plan - Adaptive Skill Tree + Plan - Progressive World Reveal). Your class sits at the centre of a starfield; six behaviour/motivation branches radiate outward, shaped by what you actually train.

OPTION C — THE HOLLOW: an ARPG loot dungeon (Diablo-style)

A branching waypoint web, loot-rarity dots, a Helltide-style Blight Surge, hidden permanent-stat Altars, a locked vault, a fog-shrouded world boss. Ash/bone/blood palette.

OPTION D — THE SEASON BOARD: a tabletop object, not a scene

A physical parchment-and-wood board game — fixed viewport, no scrolling, a snaking 16-space grid, real distance rendered as a literal dice roll ('42 km = rolled a 6'), a bobbing game-piece token, a positive-only Shortcut space.

OPTION E — THE TRAILHEAD: side-view, not top-down (Super Mario / Angry Birds world map)

A true side-view (profile) 2D-platformer landscape — rolling parallax hills, a dawn sky, a curvy dirt road with level bubbles sitting directly on the ground, a bonus chest detour, the Forest Warden's keep looming at the horizon. Warm daylight palette, a storybook illustration rather than a HUD screen.

SEASON TRACK — the progression spine

• Battle-pass model: two-lane vertical track (Free / Founder), 25 tiers, 12-day countdown, season-XP bar.
• Tiers 5–6 claimed; Tier 7 CURRENT with a live CLAIM button; 8+ locked previews.

WEEKLY EXPEDITION — this week, zoomed in

• This week's region opened up into its own 5-node run with weekly MODIFIERS. GHOST RACE bar vs your Week-2 self; guild contribution; Node 5 = the Warden.

SESSION RESULTS — the dopamine screen

• Big +485 XP, storm badge, then a TIER 7 → 8 bar that visibly crosses the line with 'Ember Cloak unlocked' + EQUIP.
• Honest XP breakdown → total. Quests ticked, a drop reveal, a personal-best callout.
